tool_config.name: sozdat_zayavku_nightdesk_demo
tool_config.description: Saves a repair request for the office and returns its number (nomer_vsluh — read it digit by digit). Call it once per problem, only after the building and apartment were confirmed and you asked the name, the access question and the text-message question. Never for a message that is not a repair, never for a danger. Say the request is in ONLY if ok is true.

dom.description: The confirmed building: tidewater, seawell or kestrel.

kvartira.description: The confirmed apartment, e.g. 4B; COMMON for a common-area problem reported by a non-resident.

kategoriya.description: The same category you passed to sortirovka_nightdesk_demo.

opisanie.description: One or two short sentences in the caller's words: what is wrong and where. No names of other people, no health details.

dostup.description: Answer to the access question: da (staff may enter when they are not home), tolko_pri_mne (only when they are home), net (call first, do not enter).

zhivotnye.description: Answer to "Are there any pets we should know about?" — only if asked.

imya.description: First and last name as the caller said it and confirmed, in Latin letters. Never a placeholder such as "Caller".

telefon.description: The callback number in E.164 format, e.g. +13475550141 — the caller's own number if it is a real phone number.

sms_soglasie.description: true ONLY if the caller clearly said yes to text messages in this call; otherwise false.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
